notes: Faster tab switching, tabs keep their zoom and position, and you can pick which sheet layers paste onto.

features: Paste layers onto a sheet you choose: there's an 'onto sheet' box beside Paste. Leave it blank to keep the sheet numbers the marks came from. Useful when the matching plan is a different sheet number in each building.
fixes: Switching between takeoff tabs no longer redraws the PDF every time - rendered sheets are kept and reused.
Each tab now keeps its own zoom, pan and scroll position instead of resetting to fit-width when you switch.
